notes.title: Who are the Trollz?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36023606/5440499b59fb0511f890fb5eb361e4a0cf745a02.jpg[/img]

[i]Yggr bore fruits—our tribe of great Trollz.[/i]

Yggr bears Trollz as mature adults, ready to function in society and take on their roles. When one of the Trollz dies, he is immediately replaced by a new one. Yggr always keeps a few embryos with a different set of genes. When a Troll is needed, a suitable embryo instantly becomes an adult specimen and is released.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36023606/9f5d24c111c4789a0847af24c3fa92a74cc237fd.jpg[/img]

[h3]Population[/h3]Yggr by default keeps the population around 10-20 specimens. When one of the Trollz dies, Yotunz immediately grows a new bud, from which an adult Troll is born.  Each specimen has a suitable set of genes—they determine his character, social function and appearance. Yggr always has a few embryos in reserve, ready to release them if necessary.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36023606/ec1c1df2a702594321793ce4603c5b8808bc9a90.jpg[/img]

[h3]Lifespan[/h3]A Yotun’s lifespan depends on his combat and survival skills. Endurance and regeneration skills of Yotunz would allow them to live as long as 50 human years. It’s amazing if we take into account the planet’s environment and life conditions. 

Yotunz grow old slowly but natural death is rare among them. Most Yotun warriors die in combat and while mining Veri in Durnar. Some don’t even reach their first birthday. On the other hand, the Yotunz who stay in the village to grow Symbionts or mushrooms live much longer than those who descend into Durnar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36023606/12d261e99fa057c6e646e76f1e00bc18a3b1ec57.jpg[/img]

[h3]Collective consciousness[/h3]Collective consciousness is an important characteristic of the tribe. Yggr remembers the lives of all the Trollz he bore and transfers those memories to the newly born ones. That’s why Trollz have such a strong bond with each other. Yotunz, the warriors, remember the deeds of their predecessors and learn from them.

However, the older the deeds, the less clear the memories are. Trollz pass down the stories of their ancestors to ensure that the brave warriors will live forever in the memory of the tribe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36023606/38896b20b5286555e7e927f508d9911fce5b1da4.jpg[/img]

[h3]BONUS: Trivia[/h3]In Norse mythology, Jötun is a race of giants from Jötunheim. They were older than gods and hostile to them. It was believed that a final battle between gods and giants would begin Ragnarök.

notes.title: Yotunz Lore: Cosmogony and Mythology
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36023606/2977b752e4763543504eb5114a9c769b8e787ca2.jpg[/img]

The main story of Arboria, a fantasy rogue-lite game, focuses on the tribe facing imminent extinction. The storyline is centered around the Trollz tribe and their Father Tree—Yggr—who's about to die, as his roots are being slowly consumed by an underground monster. 

On the edge of extinction, Trollz are forced to take drastic measures. They send their best warriors (Yotunz) to dungeons full of peril, hoping that one of them will prove himself to be the long-anticipated hero. According to the legends, a savior will come to slay Jormund and heal The Father Tree. You could be that hero.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36023606/aedc5e3d316bccba149fe2d0964c84a38015a5f5.jpg[/img]
[i]Prove that you are the Chosen One!
[/i]
[h2]Discover the past…[/h2]The world of Arboria is rich with myths. The Trollz who formed the Yotunz Tribe have many stories about the past. The tale of their origin is especially important to them, helping give comfort and inspiration to the tribe in the dark times. 

[i]In the beginning, there was only God and the ground was barren. God was lonely, until one day He noticed His shadow. So God brought the shadow to life and called him Jormund, and He was no longer alone. But Jormund crawled on the ground and grew angry that he had to look up at God. He was jealous of God’s power. 

Jormund waited and waited until God fell asleep and he bit God’s finger. Awakened by the pain, God threw Jormund away, but the shadow drank enough blood to steal some of God’s power, to gain the material form of a snake, to grow. God was afraid of Jormund, so He forced him to bite his own tail and buried him underground. To keep Jormund from returning, God ripped His hurt finger off and planted it in the ground to feed the monster. Yggr, a great tree, grew out of the finger and its roots reached deep under the ground. Since then, Jormund has been living underground, feeding on Yggr’s roots.
[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36023606/13e5290a77ce12d82907c2bc3097c6d53feaa065.jpg[/img]
[i]Behold the almighty Yggr.[/i]

That’s how the Father Tree – Yggr — was born.
Yggr bore fruits—our tribe of great Trollz. The Trollz lived in peace under the branches of Father Yggr, mining Veri, the blood of the gods for him. In return, they will be able to spend eternity in Hyggar, the land of God.

[h2]...and shape the future[/h2]This is where the real story begins. You know the past of the Yotunz Tribe, now shape its future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36023606/35a247d7ede37881466746ebb525f271e7053b4e.jpg[/img]
[i]Embark on a dangerous adventure and save your tribe![/i]

[b]BONUS: Trivia[/b]
Jörmungandr is a sea serpent in Norse mythology, a child of Loki and the giantess Angrboða. He was thrown together into the ocean around Midgard by Odin. Jörmungandr grew large, surrounded the earth and grasped its tail, later receiving the name of World Serpent or the Midgard Serpent. It was believed that Ragnarök will begin when the serpent releases its tail.

notes.title: Arboria announced
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36023606/3fcde08cf1a1f83d0539ed033db74fbdbfc361a3.jpg[/img]

[i]Warriors die. Heroes live forever.[/i]

Uncover the secrets of the dark fantasy world:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ACIpAolWb58

Coming to Steam in 2020, Arboria is a TPP  action rogue-lite game set in a dark fantasy universe. As a Yotun warrior, fight your way through procedurally generated dungeons and use symbiotic weapons to defeat unique enemies.

[h1][b]Features:[/b][/h1][list]
[*] Explore procedurally generated dungeons and a variety of other areas
[*] Use a range of Symbiotic Weapons and Bio-Mutations in combat and exploration
[*] Unlock new traits to power up future warriors
[*] Choose from a multitude of game changing upgrades
[*] Face unique enemies and bosses
[*] Meet the extraordinary denizens of the Refuge
[/list]

Warriors do not live long but they will remain forever in the stories and the blood of the Yotunz. The better you fight, the stronger, quicker and more adapted to the dangers of Durnar the future warriors will become.

Heal The Father Tree and restore the power of your tribe.
